response.justification: The candidate is a strong, experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years) with genuine systems programming depth in DLang and high-throughput backend work, but his profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and there is no evidence of MQTT, industrial protocols, IEC 62443/SDL practices, or industrial automation domain experience. His recent career trajectory (TypeScript/Node.js product work, AI tooling) points away from the C++-centric, security-regulated industrial focus this position demands.
strengths: Deep experience building low-latency, high-throughput, event-driven systems (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background including systems-level languages (DLang, some C/C++) and cloud/container tooling
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (single short role over a decade ago); C++ not listed in current skills
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), SDL processes, or protocols like Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT
Recent focus on web/full-stack TypeScript and AI tooling, not industrial automation or embedded/on-prem platform work

key_factors.factor: Strong distributed-systems and performance engineering skills
